notes.title: 4th September 2019: Server maintenance for EMERGENCY 20 and EMERGENCY 4 Deluxe
notes.content:
The EMERGENCY 4 and EMERGENCY 5, 2016, 2017 and 20 Multiplayer Matchmaking servers will undergo necessary maintenance starting on Wednesday, 4th September 2019.

They will be restarted multiple times, hindering online play. Playing in singleplayer will not be affected.

Restarts and unstable matchmaking are to be expected in the following timeframe:

12:00 - 00:00 PDT
15:00 - 03:00 EDT
19:00 - 07:00 UTC/GMT
21:00 - 09:00 CEST

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Maintenance for EMERGENCY PC servers
notes.content:
Necessary maintenance will be performed on the multiplayer and proxy servers for EMERGENCY 5, 2016, 2017 and 20. 

Connections might be unstable during that time, affecting multiplayer matches and downloading patches.

[b]Maintenance schedule for multiplayer proxy server:[/b]

March 12th, 2019 to March 13th, 2019
22:00 – 09:00 CET
21:00 – 08:00 UTC
14:00 – 01:00 PT

[b]Maintenance schedule for patch server:[/b]

March 13th, 2019 to March 14th, 2019
22:00 – 09:00 CET
21:00 – 08:00 UTC
14:00 – 01:00 PT

notes.title: New Patch for EMERGENCY PC released
notes.content:
Patch 4.2.0 brings improvements for modders and smaller bug fixes.

The patch will be applied automatically through Steam.

Patchnotes:

Gameplay
[list]
[*] Fixed error with updating fire and injury bars in Multiplay clients
[*] Fixed error that could cause switch boxes to become unusuable after being on fire
[/list]
Modding
[list]
[*] PersonAnimationController can now be overloaded
[*] Added missing API exports
[*] Expanded API with additional features (e.g. vehicle sirens, limits to zoom/pitch, automatic extinguishing)
[*] Added more code snippets to the SDK (e.g. unit logic, target points, multiplayer and editor functions)
[/list]

notes.title: EMERGENCY 2 now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042176/560c305cf2588ceea490e64816e61bde52ebba38.jpg[/img]

The classic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977840/]EMERGENCY 2[/url] is now available as a digital download on Steam and compatible with modern operating systems!

Experience some of the most iconic missions in the EMERGENCY franchise in gloriously detailed 2D. From a simple accident at a railway crossing to large scale disasters like a nuclear submarine on fire, EMERGENCY 2 offers a wide range of thrilling missions!

Take command of your rescue base and see it get populated as you acquire new vehicles. Send your vehicles to mission sites and choose exactly what team you need to manage the job at hand.

notes.title: EMERGENCY HQ is getting it's biggest update yet!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042176/1a2bb0ed7ab36291d4211af881ccb4bcb4331df5.jpg[/img]

[b]Great new features coming in the Holiday Update![/b]

EMERGENCY Land is getting ready for Winter! The weather forecast predicts snow and everyone is getting the decorations ready.

In the biggest update yet, your EMERGENCY Headquarters will be redecorated and there's lots to do. After all snow and ice pose new challenges.

But your EMERGENCY rescue team is prepared for everything!

Celebrate the winter holiday season with us and lots of new content! The Update will not only bring snow and new decorations. More will be added than in any other expansion before!

EMERGENCY HQ is our free2play mobile game, already available on iPhone, iPad and Android devices.

Download now:

Apple App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/emergency-hq/id859148736

Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sgs.emhq.android

notes.title: Server maintenance on August 8th/9th 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042176/6d493d25595bedb625291b6dbfa34e26696b55f0.jpg[/img]


Starting on Wednesday (8th of August 2018) and ending on Thursday (9th of August 2018) necessary server maintenance will be performed. EMERGENCY 5, EMERGENCY 2016, EMERGENCY 2017 and EMERGENCY 20 will be affected. 

Multiplayer will only be reliably possible through direct connection or with opened ports and you will be unable to download patches.

 

Maintenance schedule:

12:00 PM noon – 11:00 PM (PDT)

07:00 PM – 06:00 AM (UTC)

09:00 PM - 07:00 AM (CEST)

Other games and services will not be affected by the maintenance.

notes.title: EMERGENCY 20 for Mac now also on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943743/87b9aa5f38574e242dcf0bfafba10c5eab3945cb.jpg[/img]

For the 20th anniversary of EMERGENCY, Mac-Users can now enjoy EMERGENCY on Steam for the first time.

Three content-packed campaigns from EMERGENCY 5, EMERGENCY 2016 and EMERGENCY 2017, ten historical missions in new technology, developer videos, Multiplayer and Freeplay are waiting for you in the new Mac version on Steam. Of course, all the improvements and fixes of the PC versions are included.

In Multiplayer the PC variant and Mac variant of EMERGENCY 20 are compatible. So you can protect Cologne, Munich, Berlin and Hamburg together with your friends, even if one of you is commanding his units on a PC and one on Mac.

notes.title: Patch 4.1.0 is now available
notes.content:
Patch 4.1.0 has just been released and brings new improvements and some bugfixes. As always it will be downloaded and installed automatically here on Steam.

As many of you already noticed Steam trading cards have been online for some time now. And we have added some EMERGENCY 20 themed wallpapers to [url=http://world-of-emergency.com/media]our website.[/url]

Thank you for your feedback and your help in finding and identifying issues!

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*]EMERGENCY 5
[list]
[*]Hamburg flood, one car would sometimes not spawn after repeating the mission
[/list]
[*]EMERGENCY 2016
[list]
[*]Supermarket robbery, the robbers now take much longer to escape
[/list]
[*]EMERGENCY 20
[list]
[*]Tornado, fixed the collision of a fence
[*]Train Crash, fixed that one person could be placed inside a train after being freed
[*]Fixed the door of a taxi in the mass collision event
[*]Tires will now always be towed with cars in the mass collision event
[*]Nuclear disaster, evacuation vehicle now always has just 6 seats
[/list]
[*]Improved visualization of towing rotated cars
[*]Improved behaviour of the weather when repeating missions
[*]The rescue dog team now no longer can be unresponsive after getting into and out of their car
[*]The supervisor will stop giving tips after the mission has already failed
[*]Command icons in the help screen will now properly switch when switching between units pages
[*]A purely decorative pier in Munich can no longer be used to get units onto the water
[*]Fixed a rare instance where firemen ran to the edge of the map, when ordered to cut open a vehicle
[/list]
Multiplayer:
[list]
[*]Improved performance for clients
[/list]
Backstage-videos:
[list]
[*]Added new functions to the video player
[/list]
Steam:
[list]
[*]Improved synchronization with the WORLD of EMERGENCY accounts for achievements earned on Steam
[/list]
Modding:
[list]
[*]Expanded Code to make modding for multiplayer easier and added a sample plugin to the SDK
[*]„Custom“ light animations now properly use animation speeds
[*]Animations for vehicles are now moddable (turntable ladder, heavy tow truck, tow truck, motor boat transport)
[/list]

notes.title: EMERGENCY 20 for Mac coming December 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943743/fb6713f85b0b33dff11d6e59dcca94cb24f8e9d8.jpg[/img]

EMERGENCY 20 is already out on Steam, now we are working on finishing up the version for Mac. And we are especially happy that – for the first time – we can offer a macOS version here on Steam. 

EMERGENCY 20 for Mac will in all likelihood be available in December 2017.

With EMERGENCY 20, Mac users will be able to enjoy the 10 re-imagined classic missions and our developer videos. The macOS version will include all the campaigns, free play and multiplayer maps of the pc version, but will not support modding.

Mac users who own EMERGENCY 5 or EMERGENCY 2017 can also look forward to a new patch.

notes.title: EMERGENCY 20 now available on Steam!
notes.content:
EMERGENCY 20 is now available on Steam. It contains 10 classic missions from EMERGENCY 1-4 re-imagined in our most recent technology. Now you can relive the atmosphere of the older titles and enjoy the wonderful current graphics at the same time. In addition, EMERGENCY 20 contains all content from EMERGENCY 5, EMERGENCY 2016 and EMERGENCY 2017. 

For our long-term fans we have included video clips featuring EMERGENCY-Creator Ralph Stock talking about the history and design of every one of the original missions.
